standard-dialogue.player: Hello. What are you up to?

standard-dialogue.npc: Ah, I was about to collect some yak's milk to make yak cheese.

standard-dialogue.player: Eughr! Though I am curious. Can I try some?

standard-dialogue.npc: Sorry, no. The last outlander who ate my cheese was ill for a month.

standard-dialogue.player: So why don't you get ill as well?

standard-dialogue.npc: Well, we eat yak milk products every day, from when we're born. So I suppose we're used to it. Anyway I should stop yakking - haha - and get on with my work.

standard-dialogue.player: I'm glad to see that puns are common everywhere in Gielinor; even here.

treasure-trails-elite.npc: I need your help with this!

treasure-trails-elite-after-answering-co.text: You've [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!
